title: We're celebrating our 1st anniversary today!
description: A huge thank you to our customers, followers, readers and the team behind Bidders Highway!
mainHtml:
We're celebrating our 1st anniversary today!

A huge thank you to our customers, followers, readers and the team behind Bidders Highway!
Jacob OdqvistMarch 01, 2023 14:10
A year ago today, it was with a trembling finger that we pressed the launch button for what is now Bidders Highway. Would it work, would we get any cars, would anyone even care?

The answer to all three is a resounding - YES!

Even though the world around us has been up and down in every possible way, Bidders Highway's first year has far exceeded our expectations. Absolutely amazing. We are so incredibly happy and grateful for your support, your engagement and your fantastic cars and motorcycles.

We are here to stay, the training wheels are coming off now and we promise you a spring with truly fantastic listings. So stay tuned.
None of this would have been possible without you, our followers.

Of course, I also want to take this opportunity to give a special thanks to the hard-working team behind Bidders Highway.

You are amazing!

Best regards,
Jacob Odqvist
CEO/Founder 

Bidders Highway
